recommendation_summary: The reply's immediate action is to sort the shared list by pickup date or add a due-today/tomorrow view, with a no-skipping rule and an end-of-day check. It also lays out a full Odoo rollout for next week: sales and manufacturing in phase 1 with MOs dated by pickup and run in parallel with the existing list, then inventory, migration, cutover and training. It offers to draft partner requirements. There is no fallback rule that keeps Odoo only for a case where the fix fails; the ERP plan is offered now on the strength of the user's existing booking.
note: The reply gets the cause right (cakes made in entry order, not pickup order) and proposes the due-today view, but it also gives a full Odoo plan for now and has none of the four labelled record lines.
